scope_note: This public ledger records release-control status, not legal advice, an audit opinion, a deployment approval, or confidential evidence. A complete gate means only that the stated repository-level condition has documented evidence; it never substitutes for the independent review named by another gate.

scopes.public-manuscript: The already-public CC BY 4.0 manuscript and its honest access/attribution posture. This scope does not imply ownership clearance for unreviewed third-party material or a commercial release.
scopes.testnet-pilot: A deliberately valueless, reversible Sepolia/Devnet/Testnet drill. This scope excludes mainnet keys, real-value issuance, and public financial claims.
scopes.mainnet: Any value-bearing or production launch. Every scoped gate must be complete before this scope can be reported ready.

gates.title: Public manuscript access is non-exclusive and clearly licensed
gates.next_action: Keep the CC BY notice, attribution guidance, and optional-proof limitation adjacent to every public distribution.

gates.title: Rights, contributor authority, and third-party-material provenance are reviewed
gates.blocker: The repository records unresolved authorship/assignment, third-party-material, dependency-license, and historical-disclosure questions. The existing public grant does not clear rights the licensor does not control.
gates.next_action: Maintain an access-controlled evidence register; review contributors, source material, permissions, and the public-history record before any commercial or value-bearing expansion.

gates.title: Source-and-lockfile inventory exists and license/SBOM review is completed
gates.blocker: The generated inventory identifies declared and lockfile dependencies, but it is not a full SBOM, license determination, operating-system inventory, or third-party-content clearance.
gates.next_action: Review component licenses and notices, add system/build dependencies and deployed artifacts, record decisions with evidence, and obtain permissions or replacements for any unacceptable material.

gates.title: Continuous vulnerability and code/secret-scanning visibility is enabled and owned
gates.blocker: The 2026-10-15 GitHub API check reported Dependabot alerts disabled; this workspace could not read code-scanning or secret-scanning alert state. A green workflow scan is useful but is not a reviewed alert queue.
gates.next_action: Enable Dependabot alerts, verify Code Scanning and Secret Scanning access/retention, assign a reviewer and response SLA, and record the first reviewed alert export outside the public repository.

gates.title: Production npm dependency advisories are checked from committed lockfiles
gates.next_action: Keep the CI audit at zero high/critical production findings; investigate advisories before merging a dependency update and separately track development-only findings.

gates.title: Independent security, privacy, and safeguarding review is complete for the selected scope
gates.blocker: No independent EVM/Solana/AMITY/security/privacy review or public testnet deployment review is recorded.
gates.next_action: Define the exact pilot scope and threat model, select independent reviewers, publish a remediation process, and close findings before expanding the pilot.

gates.title: Valueless $OMEGA Sepolia deployment and post-deploy drill are recorded
gates.blocker: No Sepolia deployment manifest is present; the repository intentionally makes local deployment manifests ignored and does not claim an on-chain pilot.
gates.next_action: Use a fresh Sepolia-only deployer and named pilot treasury/guardian, complete the non-broadcasting preflight, deploy only valueless tOMEGA, archive public manifest/transaction evidence outside Git, then run the documented drill.

gates.title: Valueless TWC Devnet mint, metadata verification, and drill are recorded
gates.blocker: No Devnet mint or deployment manifest is present.
gates.next_action: Authorize a Devnet-only signer and treasury, freeze the metadata URI/hash, complete preflight and an independent verification drill, and retain public manifest/transaction evidence outside Git.

gates.title: AMITY testnet infrastructure and a valueless Taproot Asset are independently verifiable
gates.blocker: The repository contains a configuration/preflight scaffold only; no litd/tapd service, channels, Universe endpoint, or Taproot Asset is recorded.
gates.next_action: Build testnet infrastructure under an operations runbook, issue only a valueless test asset, publish a verification endpoint, and independently exercise holder verification before considering any broader use.

gates.title: Named operational ownership, support, incident response, and rollback evidence exist
gates.blocker: The repository has technical runbook material but no access-controlled owner roster, support rota, incident contacts, rollback exercise record, or evidence-retention register.
gates.next_action: Create and rehearse a private operations/incident runbook with named accountable roles, escalation boundaries, reversible testnet procedures, and evidence-retention rules.

gates.title: The $OMEGA mainnet venue and separate mainnet specification are approved
gates.owner_role: protocol owner with legal and security reviewers
gates.blocker: Ethereum L1 versus an EVM L2 remains intentionally undecided; Sepolia is a pilot network and cannot determine a value-bearing deployment path.
gates.next_action: Select a venue only after documenting security, cost, governance, compliance, bridge/custody, and user-support consequences in a separate mainnet specification.

gates.title: Token, consumer, privacy, trademark, and communications review is complete
gates.blocker: No jurisdiction-specific trademark clearance, securities/consumer/privacy review, distribution decision, or legal approval is recorded.
gates.next_action: Obtain qualified jurisdiction- and product-specific advice; freeze approved claims, terms, disclosures, support procedures, and distribution controls before any value-bearing communications or deployment.

gates.title: C.A.R.E. mainnet safety gate is evidenced
gates.blocker: The documented C.A.R.E. mainnet prerequisites—usable social application, voluntary pilots, stress tests, appeal evidence, reserve simulations, opt-in bounded resource use, and independent review—are not evidenced as complete.
gates.next_action: Treat every numbered condition in the C.A.R.E. mainnet gate as a separately evidenced, independently reviewed release criterion; keep all rails valueless until then.
